column3: The Hebrew reads “Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt”; NASB places the remark in parentheses. 2 Chr 10:2 reads “returned from Egypt.”
“Who were standing before Solomon” is rendered “who had served his father Solomon,” and “bring back word” as “answer.”
“Answer them” is rendered “grant them their petition,” and “all the days” as “forever.”
“Who stood before him” is rendered “served him.”
“A turn” is rendered “a turn of events.”
“Consider your own house” is rendered “look after your own house.”
“Countrymen” is rendered “relatives,” and NASB adds “went their way.”
NASB supplies “to worship” and “as far as.” Many think a phrase about Bethel has dropped out of the Hebrew.
